Phase 4 decision — RP04 REJECTED FOR THIS JANITOR PASS on 2026-08-30 at maintainer direction.

The verified finding and the full architecture/design progression were preserved as idea `unadult-emptiable-porpoise` (`41b1-a615-51bd-474c`), linked `discovered_from` this audit and tagged `architecture`, `close-workflow`, and `janitor-deferred`. The idea records the original single-context proposal, source-oriented refinement, both independent/adversarial reviews, the corrected authority/lifetime/ownership model, regression and mutation obligations, and the promotion bar.

The decisive unresolved question is ADR 0098's single operation-snapshot authority versus ADR 0005 D8/current mid-operation `sync.push` rereads. The idea must not be promoted until that choice is explicit and the close path is re-audited against the then-current code.

RP04 is excluded from Janitor Cleanup ticketization. This is a scope/design deferral, not a known-fine blessing and not a rejection of the verified finding's validity. `.joe-janitor/report-2026-08-29.md` now records the progression and disposition. No production/test/config/docs code was modified and no force, claim, or gate operation was used.
